text: Spritely 是 DSH Web 客户端插件，会在界面覆盖层放置一个随会话工作状态变化的动画精灵。它根据待命、工作、等待或错误等状态显示相应姿态，支持四种角色切换、拖动定位和自定义颜色、渐变或图片背景；背景可调整适配方式与淡化程度。用户还能在会话消息中选择文字，使用悬浮工具条复制、朗读或将引用内容放入输入框继续提问。适合希望个性化 DSH 网页界面并便捷引用对话内容的用户。偏好通过 DSH Host 设置同步；服务不可用时使用浏览器本地存储，不需要额外密钥。

Spritely adds an animated mascot to DSH Web that reacts to session activity. It offers four characters, draggable placement, and custom backgrounds. A selection toolbar can copy, read aloud, or quote conversation text into the composer. Preferences sync through DSH Host settings or browser storage.
想让 DSH 网页界面有个会跟着工作状态变化的小精灵。

怎么给 DSH 对话页面换成自己的背景颜色或图片？
能不能选中一段回复，然后直接带着引用去输入问题？
Can I personalize the DSH web page with a mascot that reacts to the agent's activity?
I want to select part of a conversation and quote it into the composer to ask a follow-up.
Spritely 的功能「状态精灵」：在 DSH 网页覆盖层显示动画角色，并依据会话活动切换姿态。点击角色可打开菜单，拖动可更改位置。
Spritely 的功能「角色切换」：用户可在菜单中选择不同精灵角色，选择结果写入角色状态源并同步偏好设置。
Spritely 的功能「自定义背景」：通过背景面板选择颜色、渐变或图片，也可上传本地图片，并设置缩放和淡化。
Spritely 的功能「选中文字操作」：在会话消息中选择文本后显示悬浮工具条，可复制、使用浏览器朗读，或把文本格式化为引用并放入输入框。
DSH 的会话回复能不能一键朗读？
我想给网页聊天背景加个渐变效果。

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 功能特性：- **四款可切换角色** —— 蓝球（Blob）、薄荷机器人（Bot）、猫咪（Cat）、幽灵（Ghost），各有独特造型与眼睛风格。
- **实时工作状态姿态** —— 待命 / 思考 / 撰写 / 工作 / 等待 / 出错，以及运行收尾时的短暂庆祝。
- **眼珠跟随鼠标**（rAF 节流）。
- **可拖拽** —— 拖到任意位置，一键归位。
- **自定义背景** —— 纯色、渐变、图片 URL、本地图片上传，支持等比居中 / 全屏拉伸缩放 + 淡化遮罩（保证文字可读）。
- **科幻 HUD 风格** —— 菜单与面板采用固定深色全息配色 + 青色霓虹描边。
- **划词悬浮工具条** —— 在会话消息里选中文字，弹出操作条：复制、朗读（浏览器语音合成）、提问（选中内容以引用块格式进入输入框，光标落到下一行等你补充）。
- **持久化** —— 角色、背景、位置保存在 DSH Host 的用户设置文档（`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`），本机的所有浏览器共享；非本机回环的浏览器（局域网访问）回退到 localStorage。

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 安装：Spritely 同时声明了 `dsh.bundle`（附带 `cordis.patch.yml` 补丁层）与 `dsh.client`（`platform: web`），一条命令即可完成安装与登记：

```bash
@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 从 npm 安装：dsh plugin --profile <name> add @wangjunjian/dsh-spritely
@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 或从 git 安装：dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:wang-junjian/spritely

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 或从本地源码：dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./spritely
```

`add` 会应用包自带的补丁层，往配置树插入 `id: ui-sprite` / `name: '@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely'` 一行；宿主 Loader 随即读到它的 `dsh.client` 元数据，serve `/plugins/@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely/client.js` 并注入 `window.__DSH_BOOT__`。

构建产物（`lib/`）不入库：git / 本地源码安装由 `prepare` 脚本自动构建，npm 包自带产物。

> 它的 peer 依赖（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`、`dsh-client-ui-layout`、`dsh-client-locale` 等）都是 dsh 自带的 in-box 包，从 dsh 安装本身解析，无需单独安装。
@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 或从本地源码：> 如果你按旧版说明手动往 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 加过 `ui-sprite` 的 row，升级后请删掉那行，避免重复登记。

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 使用：点击精灵打开菜单：

- **新会话** —— 开启新会话（默认工作区流程）。
- **归位** —— 回到默认右下角。
- **设置背景** —— 打开背景控制台（纯色、渐变、图片 URL、本地上传、缩放、淡化）。
- **选择精灵** —— 在四款角色中切换。

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 角色：| 角色 | 造型 | 配色 |
|---|---|---|
| 蓝球 Blob | 圆球 + 天线星 | 蓝 |
| 机器人 Bot | 圆角方头 + LED 眼 | 薄荷绿 |
| 猫咪 Cat | 三角耳 + 竖瞳 + 胡须 | 橙 |
| 幽灵 Ghost | 波浪底边 + 大圆眼 | 紫 |

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · 开发：```bash
npm install          # 安装 dsh peer 依赖 + 开发工具链
npm run build        # tsc（类型）+ tsdown（node 半 lib + 浏览器 client bundle）
npm test             # vitest
npm run watch        # tsdown --watch

构建产出 node 半库（`lib/index.js`、`lib/invariant.js`）和浏览器客户端 bundle（`lib/client.js`，dsh 的 `__ModuleLoader__` 闭包工厂格式），CSS Modules 由 lightningcss 内联。

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · Spritely：English | [Chinese](README.md)

> *Your spritely work companion* — a floating mascot for the dsh web UI that reacts to the agent's live work state.

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · Spritely：Spritely (formerly the `ui-sprite` plugin) is a dsh client plugin that drops a small, animated character into the corner of the web interface. It watches the agent's activity — idle, thinking, writing, running tools, waiting on you, erroring, or finishing a run — and plays a matching pose, tracks your cursor with its eyes, and can be dragged anywhere.

Four characters: Blob · Bot · Cat · Ghost

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · Features：- **Four switchable characters** — Blob (blue ball), Bot (mint robot), Cat (amber kitty), Ghost (violet specter), each with its own body and eye style.
- **Live work-state poses** — idle, thinking, writing, working, waiting, error, and a brief celebration when a run settles.
- **Cursor-tracking eyes** — pupils follow the mouse (rAF-throttled).
- **Draggable** — grab and move the mascot anywhere; reset returns it to the corner.
- **Customizable background** — solid colors, gradients, image URLs, and local image upload, with fit (contain / stretch) and a fade veil for legibility.
- **Sci-fi HUD styling** — the menu and panels use a fixed dark holographic palette with a cyan neon frame.
- **Selection toolbar** — select text in a conversation message and a floating bar appears: copy, read aloud (browser SpeechSynthesis), and ask (the selection lands in the composer as a Markdown quote block, caret ready on the next line).
- **Persisted** — your character, background, and position live in the DSH host's user-settings document (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`), shared by every loopback browser on the machine; non-loopback browsers (LAN access) fall back

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · Install：Spritely declares both `dsh.bundle` (shipping a `cordis.patch.yml` patch layer) and `dsh.client` (`platform: web`), so a single command installs and registers it:

```bash
@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile <name> add @wangjunjian/dsh-spritely
@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · or from git：dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:wang-junjian/spritely

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · or from a local checkout：Build artifacts (`lib/`) are not committed: installs from git or a local checkout build them via the `prepare` script, and the npm package ships them prebuilt.

> Its peer dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`, `dsh-client-ui-layout`, `dsh-client-locale`, …) are in-box dsh packages resolved from the dsh installation itself — they need not be installed separately.

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · or from a local checkout：> If you previously added the `ui-sprite` row to `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` by hand (per the old instructions), remove that line after upgrading to avoid a duplicate registration.

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · Usage：Click the mascot to open its menu:

- **New session** — start a new session (default workspace flow).
- **Reset position** — return the mascot to its default corner.
- **Set background** — open the background console (colors, gradients, image URL, local upload, scale, fade).
- **Switch sprite** — pick one of the four characters.

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · Characters：| Character | Look | Palette |
|---|---|---|
| Blob | round ball + antenna star | blue |
| Bot | rounded head + LED eyes | mint green |
| Cat | triangular ears + vertical pupils + whiskers | amber |
| Ghost | wavy hem + big round eyes | violet |

@wangjunjian/dsh-spritely README · Development：```bash
npm install          # installs dsh peer dependencies + dev tooling
npm run build        # tsc (types) + tsdown (node-half lib + browser client bundle)
npm test             # vitest
npm run watch        # tsdown --watch

The build emits the node-half library (`lib/index.js`, `lib/invariant.js`) and the browser client bundle (`lib/client.js`) in dsh's `__ModuleLoader__` closure-factory format, with CSS Modules inlined by lightningcss.
